clock.note: the lowest DDR3 clock UberDDR3 calibrates on this board (160 fails; 300 works); 75 MHz controller builds fail the controller's own routing once real decode logic exists

what_ran.workload: BitNet b1.58 2B4T layer-0 self_attn.q_proj rows 0-319 (819,200 weights), activations seed 27, both formats
what_ran.read_discipline: one outstanding request, 8 idle clocks after each ack (overlapping requests answer zero data, #75)

bit_exact.verdict: 320/320 Y lines equal the t27/C reference in both formats

measurement.aggregation: Counter values per run are arithmetic means over all runs; stall percentages are 100 * summed counter / summed cycles. Stall counters can overlap and are not an additive cycle breakdown.

counter_correction.mapping: v1 wait_stalls is w.a (issue-hold cycles); v1 consumer_stalls is w.b (request-wait cycles). Actual consumer stalls are n.b, discarded by v1.
counter_correction.missing: Consumer stalls for the 12-run series cannot be recovered; null is unknown, not zero.
counter_correction.golden_scope: Separate golden runs have 19 (dense5) and 65 (baseline2) consumer stalls; these are not the missing 12-run measurements.

memory_bound.definition: Memory-limited delivery requires a test isolated from result-output backpressure.
memory_bound.observed: dense5: request issue held 99.9440% of cycles; request wait 0.2465%; consumer stalls unavailable in the 12-run capture; baseline2: request issue held 99.9310% of cycles; request wait 0.3082%; consumer stalls unavailable in the 12-run capture
memory_bound.verdict: DDR3 latency as the bottleneck is not established. The timed matvec includes UART result backpressure: y_pending stops FIFO consumption until the emitter accepts the row. Separate computation from result emission before testing the bandwidth thesis (measured dense5/baseline2 ratio 1.0000).

not_measured: power and energy (no instrument on the bench)
tokens per second and model quality (one layer chunk, not a model)
x32 DDR3, and DDR3 above 480 MT/s (the 667 MT/s class was never built)
bus-rate delivery (consumer A): the pipelined reads the port answers with zero data are the open seam (#62, #65)
